proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C E hABC hE hpar
  have core : ∀ s t : ℝ, (line[ℝ, (AffineMap.lineMap A B s : P), (AffineMap.lineMap A C t : P)]).Parallel line[ℝ, B, C] → s = t := by
    intro s t hpar
    have hli : ∀ a b : ℝ, a • (B -ᵥ A) + b • (C -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
      intro a b h
      by_contra hab
      apply hABC
      rcases not_and_or.mp hab with ha | hb
      · have hB : B -ᵥ A = (-b / a) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
          have h2 : a • (B -ᵥ A) = (-b) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
            rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
          rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
        have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-b / a) A C
        rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hB, vsub_vadd] at h3
        have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
        rwa [Set.insert_comm] at h4
      · have hC : C -ᵥ A = (-a / b) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
          have h2 : b • (C -ᵥ A) = (-a) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
            rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h
          rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
        have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-a / b) A B
        rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hC, vsub_vadd] at h3
        have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
        rwa [Set.insert_comm, Set.pair_comm] at h4
    rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
    have hmem : (AffineMap.lineMap A C t : P) -ᵥ (AffineMap.lineMap A B s : P) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {C -ᵥ B} := by
      rw [← hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    have hCB : C -ᵥ B = (C -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_vadd_cancel_right] at hk
    rw [hCB] at hk
    have h0 : (s - k) • (B -ᵥ A) + (k - t) • (C -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) := by
      have : t • (C -ᵥ A) - s • (B -ᵥ A) - k • ((C -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A)) = (0 : V) := by
        rw [hk]; simp
      rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← this]; module
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hli _ _ h0
    linarith
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hE
  have ht := core (⅟2) t hpar
  subst ht
  rfl
